unit.why: A single narrative, quoted from the preface of Maamar Mordekhai, tells how the Seer of Lublin sent its author to spend Shabbat Behukotai with the Maggid of Kozienice and what he heard there.

stories.start_quote: בסה״ק מאמר מרדכי בהקדמה מבנו וז״ל
stories.end_quote: נדפס בפנים בס׳ מאמר מרדכי הנ"ל] עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin tells his disciple, the author of Maamar Mordekhai, that the Maggid of Kozienice turns the rebuke into blessings; the disciple goes there for Shabbat Behukotai, hears the Maggid read the rebuke in a thunderous voice and cry out 'would that we merit to be at this hour', and conceives a hundred interpretations of the verse.
